[1] registers via kseg1 (0xB3......), the address form --diag uses:
  soc_id       @0xB300002C = 0x12000002
  subsoctype1  @0xB3540238 = 0x22220000
  subsoctype2  @0xB3540250 = 0x00000000

  cpu_id=0x2000  sub1=0x2222  sub2=0x0000
  => T20X   (loader dir: t20x)

  window[+0x38] = 0x22220000  == subsoctype1 (match)
  window[+0x50] = 0x00000000  == subsoctype2 (match)
